verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents a real public API with OAuth2 client_credentials auth, service accounts, discoverable authorization server metadata, and defined operations (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions) supporting pagination/delta sync — enough for programmatic/agentic driving of the product. However, no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec or llms.txt was found (probes returned 404s), and there's no evidence of broader write operations (e.g., granting equity, managing transactions) via API beyond read endpoints. Missing for 10: discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable schema, evidence of broader write/action endpoints, independent third-party corroboration of API usage.
